overal.goal: PUT /settings has no optimistic concurrency: two writers that each read the settings and then save lose each other's unrelated changes only through the field-level patches the UI sends, and a same-field race is last write wins. Add an expected-version check (an If-Match on a settings version, like plans and tasks have) so a stale write is refused with 409. LOW PRIORITY: the Settings UI already sends field-level patches and shows a changed-elsewhere notice.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono, zod, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/api.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Filed with phase 5 of the UI redesign (2026-11-02), low priority; not started.

tests.strategy: API tests: PUT /settings with a stale If-Match answers 409 and changes nothing; without If-Match it behaves as before; the UI sends the version.
